Educational flat-design concept map — mind map illustration, square 1:1 format. Italian middle school textbook (scuola secondaria I grado), DigComp I level. Central hub: large rounded rectangle "📡 Sistemi di trasporto e mobilità sostenibile", solid fill #6A1B9A, white bold sans-serif label, subtle drop shadow. Five branch clusters radiate from the hub with smooth curved lines. Each branch has a colored pill label and 2–5 smaller rounded child nodes:
  • INNESCA [#5E35B1]: "Sistemi di trasporto e mobilità…"
  • ESPLORA [#1565C0]: "Lo studente confronta i sistemi di…" | "stradale" | "ferroviario" | "aereo"
  • SPERIMENTA [#E65100]: "trasporto sostenibile / sustainable transport" | "logistica / logistics"
  • AGISCI [#00695C]: "Progetta il piano di mobilità sostenibile per la…" | "somministra un sondaggio ai compagni su come vengono…" | "Professione futura: Digital Communication Specialist"
  • RIPASSA [#F57F17]: "trasporti" | "mobilità sostenibile" | "emissioni" | "intermodalità" | "trasporto sostenibile"
Style rules: white background, all labels in Italian, branch nodes solid fill (branch color) with white text, hub accent stripe #6A1B9A on bottom edge only, connecting lines 2px curved matching branch color, no photographs, no decorative frames, no gradients, clean radial balanced layout, Inter/Nunito-style sans-serif typography, WCAG AA contrast, flat vector illustration, 1:1 square.
